name: safeai-613
description: Monorepo containing: apps/client (React+Vite+TS), apps/server (Node+Express+TS), apps/agents (Python agent modules, each with its own manifest.json). Each app is an independent npm project (no npm workspaces) - workspace-driven dependency hoisting was found to alter apps/server's resolved dependency tree enough to break its TypeScript build, so each app installs and builds in full isolation instead, matching how the Dockerfiles already build them.
